component.name: zwift-steamos
component.summary: Zwift from the Steam UI on SteamOS

description.p: Installs and maintains the Windows Zwift app so it starts from the native Steam UI on SteamOS (Steam Machine, Steam Deck, HTPC): GE-Proton as a Steam compatibility tool, the wine prefix owned by Steam, ANT+ through the included libusb0 bridge and Bluetooth LE through GE-Proton's winebth driver. Launches are wrapped by a pre-launch script that refreshes the sign-in token, checks for game updates and (optionally) toggles Zluggish offline servers via ZWIFT_OFFLINE_HOST=.

The package is the installer and control plane; Wine itself runs natively under Steam, not inside the flatpak sandbox. One optional sudo step (setup-system.sh) enables ANT+ sticks and Zluggish offline mode.
First SteamOS-native release: Steam shortcut + GE-Proton11-14 compat tool, no umu-launcher, Zluggish offline mode via launch env, flatpak installer.
